shared_elements: carved stone human figure (head and upper torso)
beard or facial hair rendered as incised texture
circular disc motif (chest boss / pendant earring)
banded or repeated incised patterning on the body/garment
weathered stone surface displayed in a museum setting
justification: Both are stone images of a bearded, head-dressed human confined to head-and-torso, with a prominent circular element and rows of repeated incised patterning across the chest, so a couple of generic correspondences exist. But A is a heavily eroded frontal figure carved in the round with blunt, worn low-legibility markings, while B is a crisply cut, flat rectangular slab bearing a strict profile head in shallow relief with fine, controlled ornamental detail — different medium, viewpoint and level of finish.
